apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: {name: harbor}
spec:
  selector: {app: harbor}
  ports: [{name: web, port: 80, targetPort: http}]
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: harbor-lab, labels: {app: harbor}}
spec:
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: harbor-service:lab
      imagePullPolicy: Never
      ports: [{name: http, containerPort: 8080}]
